## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `staging`
- [ ] New logic has a test in `test/<area>_test.dart`
- [ ] Visible texts are in `lib/l10n/app_it.arb` **and** `app_en.arb` (no hard-coded strings)
- [ ] Values saved in CSV stay in Italian; new columns at the end, old rows still readable
- [ ] Visual changes checked in the 4 themes (dark/light × red/neon), screenshots below
- [ ] No API keys, personal data, backups, CSV or GPX files in the commits
- [ ] If the data the app collects changes: privacy policy updated and `versioneTermini` bumped
